accept.title: Agree to the new terms
accept.body: We have changed our terms. Read the documents below and agree to continue.
accept.error: Your agreement was not saved. Please try again.

terms.1: The school owns its data. We never sell it.
terms.2: Fees guardians pay go straight to the school's account; we never hold the school's money.
terms.3: You can leave at any time and download all your data to Excel first.

privacy.1: We keep data only to run the school's work and keep the service safe.
privacy.2: One school can never see another school's data.
privacy.3: We never sell data or use it for ads.

dpa.1: All student, guardian and staff data belongs to the school.
dpa.2: We use it only on the school's instructions, and our staff keep it confidential.
dpa.3: If you leave, you get your data back, and we tell you about any breach.
